content:
rachael: sketching a small safety schematic for multi-region cutovers: focus on quorum backoff + consent gating. want quick eyes.

matt: high level?

rachael: short flow: consent check -> KMS preflight -> KV snapshot -> prewarm -> canary -> quorum backoff lease-swap -> promote.

jyoti: propose quorum backoff: controller coordinates; if no controller ack in 20s, proxies enter exponential backoff windows (2s, 5s, 12s) and require 3/5 proxy quorum before swapping. ballot tie-breaker: higher cutover_id wins.

sam: add consent gating: routing layer reads consent_stamp_ts; if >24h stale, block and surface onboarding task to legal. also exclude GDPR-no-copy tenants from batch.

matt: add inflight cap: hold canary if inflight_requests_per_tenant > 300 after prewarm. prevents queue cascades.

rachael: rollback triggers we should codify: canary error_rate >0.5% OR p95>220ms OR checksum_mismatch>1% OR quorum failed to clear within 3m -> abort. include explicit operator revert commands.

infra-bot: deploybot: noted — will flag cutovers that lack consent_stamp freshness check.

rachael: thanks. i'll draft a tiny RFC addendum and a compact playbook snippet. ping here for objections.
